svg.title: TOPAK C3 — The lease is the credential: twelve fields, one round, one live lease per principal
svg.desc: ADR-0031 fixes a closed schema: every field is an authority claim, and a capability that is not a field is not carried; adding one is a mechanism release. The lease is granted for one round and ends with it, its fence is the Paxos log index at grant, renewal only narrows, and every way a lease ends subtracts authority. Since Batch 34 the record also says who grants and who denies (A3, provisional): a first lease from a quorum, the next round and every stop from an operator.
svg.text: TOPAK · C3

text.tspan: The lease is the credential: twelve fields, one round, one live lease per principal

svg.text: ADR-0031 fixes a closed schema: every field is an authority claim, and a capability that is not a field is not carried; adding one is a mechanism release. The lease is granted for one round and ends with it, its fence is the Paxos log index at grant, renewal only narrows, and every way a lease ends subtracts authority. Since Batch 34 the record also says who grants and who denies (A3, provisional): a first lease from a quorum, the next round and every stop from
an operator.

text.tspan: At most one live lease per principal; a grant requires that none is

svg.text: live (§2, C1). Without it, monotone renewal guarantees nothing: take a
fresh grant instead. The first model check found exactly that.
The fence is the Paxos log index at grant: leases, admits and
issuances are ordered by one log, and a stale lease is detected by
comparing indices.
The field list is the per-round TCB (§6): the one slice of the trusted
base that is derived rather than declared; the rest is ADR-0045's table.
Rung 0 is Mediated, always (§3). The reference grants rung 0 and,
through its launcher, rung 1 and a SIMULATED rung 3 (ADR-0033 A7,
B29; G10 §2.3): no real principal is Contained, and an operator or an
emergency seat is Mediated by design.
The appraisal is not a field (ADR-0034 §3.2, A3, B29): the reference
keeps it beside the lease on its LeaseRecord, with ended, the action
count, the sequence number and the session counter (I39, I41), and
since 2026.10.05 the round's labels and, on an emergency lease, the
person's key and the envelope.
Confinement is necessary, not sufficient for Contained: the
provenance axis must also clear (§3; ADR-0034 §4; ADR-0035
Proposed).

text.tspan: How a lease ends at the reference (

svg.text: Nine reasons, serialized snake_case: submitted, abstained, voted,
expired, fenced, revoked, rules_changed, operator, renewed.
renewed is an end: a renewal closes the old record and opens a
narrower one at the new fence, so "same lease, new fence" is two
records in state and one lease in the record's sense (§4).
ADR-0042 §5's seal table has every one a Run lease can have except
renewed; submitted, abstained and voted are Build's.
rules_changed and voted are ends ADR-0031 does not name (right).
Unchanged by the rebuild. An operator's signed EndRound ends as
operator, its Revoke as revoked, its FenceEpoch as fenced

text.tspan: No live lease: the principal's slot is free

svg.text: The only state from which a grant is possible: one live lease per principal, and per seat, which
ADR-0037 §1 makes the same rule.

text.tspan: grant (§2): an admit decision at a fresh fence

svg.text: None live for the principal (§2); the target is not in the revocation set (§5).
ttl ≤ T_persona, refused by the mechanism, not policy (A2; built, ADR-0033 A6).
The alphabet is inside the seat kind's row and domain (ADR-0037 §4).
The bundle revision verifies under the rules' bundle_keys (ADR-0033 A6; G10 §2.7).
At rung ≥ 1: an Attested appraisal at the declared rung, nonce = hash(epoch, log index, principal, round);
Unattestable or Contested refuses, never a lower rung (ADR-0034 §3). At the reference it is re-checked at
apply on every replica (ADR-0033 A7, B29).
fence := the Paxos log index of the grant entry; consensus-ordered, like every authority increase.
A first lease: granted by the mechanism when a quorum completes, an anchor issuance (rostered
seats, the first operators) or a promotion's tally on a seating. No request. Not built: at the reference
the unsigned socket seats, a BOOTSTRAP path, and whoever reaches it can seat (ADR-0050 §10;
A successor grant (Regrant, C1): the next round, every field the last lease's or narrower, only
round advancing; by an operator with a live lease and a live peer (C5), never itself (C6), with a task
label the seating allows (C8).
Anything wider (Persona, bundle, confinement, seat, a wider alphabet) is a first lease and needs a
quorum.
An emergency lease is activated by the break-glass roster's quorum for one person and one round
Every action carries epoch and lease; the mechanism compares epoch, fence and
rulesEpoch on each one and assumes the six checked fields for the round.
An admit decided under a lease that has since ended is void at apply (ADR-0033 §4).
May narrow the alphabet or shorten the ttl (again ≤ T_persona). Never adds authority:
lease(n+1) ⊑ lease(n).
Keeps bundle, round, role and confinement, digest and rung (R1, R2, A1).
Re-attests the Persona and confinement with a fresh nonce (ADR-0034 §3.6). Attested: same rung.
Unattestable: refused, the lease lapses. Contested: never at renewal (finding 5).
It measures the launch again, not the running guest.
By an operator (Renew, C2), on the successor's terms (C5, C6). An emergency lease is never
renewed (ADR-0052 §3).

The slot frees once the end is ordered. A change of any kept field (bundle, round, role, confinement digest or
rung) is a grant, so it takes this path: end the round, then a fresh grant at a new fence (§4). Elevation of the rung is
likewise a fresh grant (ADR-0036 R1, Proposed).
slot free: a new grant may follow,
unless the target is revoked

text.tspan: The lease's life (§2, §4, §5, §7; E1; A1, A2)
ADR-0031 §5 (R3): revocation has two tools, chosen by scope

svg.text: Persona revocation, confinement-profile failure, operator revocation of a known
principal
Ends every live lease the target matches, and bars every later grant it matches. A target is a principal, a Persona
digest or a confinement digest. The epoch, and every other lease, is untouched
Scope unknown or fleet-wide: e-stop, suspected compromise of the mechanism or
anchor, a bundle that must reach every principal now (§4)
Increments the epoch. Every lease at the old epoch is fenced (ADR-0022 §2), and every live round ends

Both are enforced by the mechanism ahead of the floor; both subtract, so neither needs a quorum; both change replicated state, so both are consensus-ordered (ADR-0033 §4). Lifting a revocation would add authority and no record says

who may (G10 item 22, as at G9). Who denies (A3, provisional): both tools are an operator's, signed with its Persona's key, with no quorum and no peer; the epoch fence needs a live lease, the others a live lease or a fresh sign-on assertion.
The signature is the attribution F2 asks for (ADR-0028).

text.tspan: A2: the TTL is bounded by

svg.text: A lease's ttl, at grant and at every renewal, is at most T_persona, a policy-floor value (floor/genesis-values.json): the Persona is re-attested at least that
often.
Built at the reference (ADR-0033 A6, Batch 23): refused at grant and renewal in apply, with a mutation test at the bound's edge; Mechanism.tla carries both
checks.
The value is a placeholder (one hour) and expiry runs on the local clock: the bound is enforced, the interval still drifts (G10 item 62, as at G9; ADR-0045 finding
Between two re-attestations a substituted Persona is undetected for at most T_persona (Consequences).
Expiry is a read of a local monotonic clock with an asymmetric margin: a lease is treated as expired early rather than late, so clock error subtracts authority (§7).
ADR-0032 generalises the rule: an interval whose failure subtracts may use a local clock; one whose failure adds or preserves authority needs trusted time. Clocks
buy liveness, never safety: an expired lease its holder still believes in is rejected by the epoch fence.
E1 (Batch 8): expiry is read locally and then ordered, so every replica agrees when the one-live-lease slot frees.
ADR-0033 A13 (B33): the reference could order EndRound(Expired) for a lease just granted; the observation is now recorded before the lock is released. The clock
is outside every module, so no proof could find it; whether any other fact kept beside the state is recorded late is not audited (G10 item 96).
An emergency lease ends with its round: at the round bound R, at its ttl, which is at most T_persona like any lease's, or when the person ends it; sooner at a
fence or a revocation, which any operator of the domain may make (ADR-0052 §3).
No successor and no renewal: an operator's Regrant or Renew naming the seat is refused, and another round is another quorum.
No issued TTL. R8, the break-glass TTL, was withdrawn (ADR-0026 W1, 2026.10.04): it would have needed trusted time. The time box is the round, on the clock the
corpus already accepts for a lease.
Full mechanism

Reachability: a renewal happens

Reachability: one principal is revoked and another's lease stays live (R3)
Renewal may add authority
The mechanism skips the epoch check
Contained ignores the rung
Renewal ignores the role (R1)
A grant ignores the revocation set (R3)
Reachability: a renewal at rung ≥ 1 (A1)
Renewal may lower the rung (the rule as ratified at R3) (A1)

The finding the check bought (C1): the first run failed on the full mechanism. A Grant replaced a live lease with wider authority, which satisfied every clause as first written, because §4 governs renewal and this was a grant. §2 now states the one-live-lease rule. Model: two principals, a two-variant alphabet, rungs 0–3, roles author and voter; the round number and the bundle are not modelled (the reference checks the bundle: renewal_cannot_swap_the_bundle). Earlier runs: R1 1,605,720 states, R3 1,746,048.

text.tspan: Since 2026.10.02: the four invariants are proved (ADR-0031 B25; ADR-0046 §4); since 2026.10.04 the proof is certified (ADR-0046 A1)

svg.text: spec/Lease_A1_proof.tla (6f39c7711252c8de) proves, for every behaviour and every epoch and fence bound: LeaseAuthorityMonotone not under M_RENEW, M_ROLE, M_LOWER; NoActionUnderFencedEpoch not under M_FENCE; Rung0NeverContained not under M_RUNG; RevokedStaysStopped not under M_REVOKE. 200 obligations, by the prover T-0045-31. Certified: 121 closed by the prover's normalization, 73 by SMT with a proof the ethos checker accepted, 1 by Isabelle, and 5 temporal steps by LS4, which no
checker confirms.

The frozen Lease.tla is not separately proved: its invariants are Lease_A1's at rungs 0..2. The rows above stay with TLC; the proof is of the module, not of the reference's grant path (T-0045-28). Who grants (A3) is not in this module: Operators.tla checks it (ADR-0050 §10).
